contexts.name: Voice & Emotion Library
contexts.description: Catalog of available voices and emotion presets; parses emotion-tagged text segments and resolves them to voice/temperature settings for expressive synthesis.

contexts.name: Voice Cloning & Ingest Pipeline
contexts.description: Turn a short reference clip into a reusable voice embedding: audio cleanup to 24kHz mono, speaker separation, emotion previews, export to safetensors served like any built-in voice.

contexts.name: Concurrency Engine & Metrics
contexts.description: Bounded pool of independent Pocket TTS model instances with admission queue, HTTP 429 backpressure, and live metrics (in-flight, queue depth, latency percentiles, real-time factor); wav concat and mp3 encoding.

contexts.name: Speech Synthesis API
contexts.description: ElevenLabs-compatible HTTP endpoint: POST /v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id} returns wav/mp3/pcm audio with timing headers, plus /health and /metrics; optional xi-api-key auth and API-key management router.

contexts.name: Packaging & Deployment
contexts.description: Containerized deployment of the CPU-only Arm-native service: Dockerfile, Python dependency pinning, and the hackathon-facing runbook.

contexts.name: Load Testing & Benchmarks
contexts.description: Ramp parallel requests against the service and report the degradation knee, throughput ceiling, latency percentiles, CPU/RAM — reproducible across Arm variants (Graviton, dev box).

contexts.name: Auth & Profile
contexts.description: Firebase-backed sign-in, session state via useAuth provider, user menu, and profile page.

contexts.name: API Key Management
contexts.description: Create, reveal once, and revoke API keys for programmatic access; ledger-style UI with secret reveal flow backed by keys API routes.

contexts.name: Voice Creation Studio
contexts.description: Upload/record a reference clip and create a new cloned voice: waveform lab UI plus ingest job API routes (scan, speaker pick, per-emotion preview, commit).

contexts.name: Character & Voice Management
contexts.description: Browse and manage characters and their cloned voices: character table with tags, per-character emotion rack with audio previews, an audition matrix that renders every recorded emotion on one identical line, CRUD via characters/voices API routes.

contexts.name: Ops Transparency
contexts.description: Live engine telemetry in the studio: polls the backend's /metrics through a server-side proxy and renders in-flight, queue depth, latency percentiles and realtime factor — with an explicit degraded-connection state and no fabricated zeros.

contexts.name: TTS Playground
contexts.description: Interactive console to type text, pick a voice and emotion, and hear synthesized speech; includes an emotion A/B that renders one line under two emotions side by side. Streams audio through server-side proxy routes that hide the backend and avoid CORS.

contexts.name: App Shell & Landing
contexts.description: Marketing landing page and root layout: hero, copy content, global styles, and Next.js configuration.

contexts.name: Emotion Glyph Art
contexts.description: Animated glyph artwork per emotion (happy, sad, angry, calm, excited, confused, whisper) rendered as EmotionGlyph/EmotionArt components; emotion metadata shared with the playground.

contexts.name: UI Design System
contexts.description: Shared visual language for the studio: app frame with navigation, primitives, design tokens, prototype tab switcher, and the StudioDark theme variant.
